sources.title: Republic of Korea MOFA Overseas Safety: Ukraine entry information
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Republic of Korea
sources.officialityEvidence: Korea MOFA's live Overseas Safety destination page records both the ordinary-passport waiver and Korea's operative travel prohibition, which the project taxonomy cannot combine safely.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Ordinary passports are visa-free for 90 days in 180, but Ukraine is a Korean travel-prohibition country.

sources.title: Djibouti eVisa service
sources.publisher: National Agency for State Information Systems, Republic of Djibouti
sources.officialityEvidence: Djibouti's live state e-government page proves electronic issuance but publishes no Republic of Korea ordinary-passport eligibility schedule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Une fois que la demande est approuvée, l'eVisa est envoyé au demandeur par courrier électronique.

sources.title: eVisa South Sudan
sources.publisher: Ministry of Interior, Department of E-Visa and Immigration Service, South Sudan
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Interior Ministry portal proves pre-travel PDF issuance but asks applicants to determine eligibility without publishing a Republic of Korea passport result.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Are you eligible for a South Sudan Visa? Start the application process by creating an account.
